insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes through the orderUpdate GraphQL mutation. This change affects unfulfilled orders and applies as of August 31, 2026. The order's taxes are recalculated against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders, especially if their apps handle shipping address changes. They should test their apps to ensure compatibility with the new tax calculation behavior. The orderUpdate mutation in the GraphQL Admin API is affected. No migration is required, but testing is recommended to handle potential tax calculation changes.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when shipping addresses are updated, ensuring compliance with tax regulations. This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations for their orders.
insight.why_it_matters: This change ensures accurate tax calculations and compliance with tax regulations, which is crucial for merchants. It also reflects Shopify's commitment to providing a robust and reliable platform for commerce.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and the updateCart standard action updates cart attributes. A new shopify:cart:attributes-update event fires whenever an attributes update is initiated.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts is now available, allowing AI agents to search catalogs, manage carts, and go to checkout on behalf of shoppers.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts without a paid plan.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more accurate order tracking.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps better reflect real-world fulfillment operations.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, to build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 removes deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, and adds flags to avoid prompts in app config link.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making.

updates.title: The shopify-account component for customer accounts is now a Theme Store requirement
updates.summary: The shopify-account component for customer accounts is now a Theme Store requirement, supporting passwordless sign-in and automatic sign-in with Shop Pay.

updates.title: createdAt is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions
updates.summary: The createdAt field is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions, allowing for more accurate customer account creation tracking.

updates.title: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes
updates.summary: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, ensuring accurate tax calculations for unfulfilled orders.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefronts, fulfillment, and Hydrogen capabilities

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts. Additionally, Oxygen is now available on development stores for Hydrogen storefront deployment.

themes.title: Fulfillment and Order Management
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated. New fields are also available for cash management activities and drawers in POS.

themes.title: Hydrogen and Development Tools
themes.detail: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and the CLI has been updated to version 4.6.0 with removed deprecated features and added flags for app configuration.
